Stiffness = 0.7 pt ; les autres CC compt: Stiffness = 0.7 pt; other counted CC = 1.0 pt. The CC that reaches/exceeds 2.0 is applied normally, becomes the new CC Timer source with its own measured duration, then immunity begins. Immunity only blocks following CC and never removes this count. Example: 1.0 + 1.0 = 2 CC applied; 0.7 + 0.7 + 0.7 = 3 CC applied.
